scripts.dev: DB_HOST=postgresdb DB_PORT=5432 DB_NAME=transactiondb DB_USER=user DB_PASSWORD=password ts-node src/index.ts
scripts.db:reset: PGPASSWORD=password psql -h postgresdb -U user -d transactiondb -c 'DROP TABLE IF EXISTS transaction_logs CASCADE;' && PGPASSWORD=password psql -h postgresdb -U user -d transactiondb -f schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: wget -O- https://nurburg-dev-fluentbit.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/0005-transactions.csv | PGPASSWORD=password psql -h postgresdb -U user -d transactiondb -c "\COPY transaction_logs FROM STDIN CSV HEADER"
